_comment: team -> either a starting XI (list of players) OR {"out": [injured/suspended players]}. `predict` downgrades a team's attack if a PRIMARY scorer (>=10% of recent goals) is missing. Edit as lineups/injuries are announced.
_argentina_note: Confirmed XI vs Algeria 2026-06-16 was a 4-4-2 (Messi+Lautaro both started => attack x1.00). NOTE: to model Lautaro being benched, use {"out":["Lautaro Martinez"]} — the XI-list matcher misses him because surname 'Martinez' collides with Lisandro/Emiliano Martinez who stay in the XI.
_r32_injury_note: Confirmed R32 absences recorded for documentation. Neither changes the model: Schlotterbeck is a defender (attack-only model ignores him) and Diego Gomez is not a PRIMARY scorer (>=10% of recent goals), so both multipliers stay x1.00.
